narr: Thunderstorms developed along a cold front as it moved through South-Central Texas. Some of these storms produced large hail and heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding of a low water crossing on Cypress Ln. at Black House Creek in Cedar Park.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing McNeil Dr. at Mopac in Wells Branch.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding closing CR 349 at Opossum Creek east of Granger.
lsr: Low water crossing flooded on Cypress Lane.
McNeil Drive at MoPac closed due to flooding.
CR349 at Opossum Creek closed due to flooding.
